scope: OpenFly-specific repair, not a broad literature survey

sources.finding: Maintainer acknowledged a historical pose-collection bug and later said the Hugging Face data was fixed. Our eight local anomalies are independently measured; this thread does not establish they are the same bug.
Users reported inability to ascend. Contributor discussed rarity of vertical data and showed examples; no unambiguous checkpoint normalization mapping was supplied in the fetched discussion.
A user independently questions why compressed forward9 begins at frame2. Our start/end audit reproduces the alignment discrepancy; the report alone was not treated as proof.
Contributor says they did not test quantization. This does not establish that our NF4 inference is wrong.
Collaborator describes keyframe training and stepwise history before keyframe detection; says released weights trained six epochs.
Released RLDS metadata includes multiple vlnv datasets and separate statistics. Downloaded lightweight metadata only; no bulk shards or unverified mapping inferred.
Closed-loop success uses goal-distance threshold20m; distinguish from strict next-action agreement.
